items.title: Albert "Fernandez" Walters Interview, 1959-01-05
items.q: The drama was Alexey Raycart, Raycart's brother.

ctx.x: That's right. Like a little light bulb? Yes. Like a little light bulb. Looked like a little light bulb. Yeah. Then eventually after that they started taking Chris Keller came behind. Well, I mean, he started taking those rubber plungers. And he started making them out of that. Later in the years, I mean, came wow-wow mutes and all the way. You didn't have to use all that. What you had to do is put your hand on it and work it.

Who was in the chameleon band when you came with them? Did they have the same, when you came with them on trumpet, did they have the same line-up? Did they have the same drama, for example? Who was the drama on the bass?
The drama was Alexey Raycart, Raycart's brother.
